success.description: Each opponent in your engagement suffers 1 stress. The attack gains +1 damage per enemy in the engagement if both {De} and {Dc} have been invested in this Enhance.

bane.description: Your target gains a Misfortune Die to his next action.

conservative.requirements: Two melee weapons equipped, Weapon Skill & Intimidation trained. Enhances a Melee Attack Special: Play this card when you make a Melee Attack. You may remove dice from your dice pool. If you do, you gain the bonuses listed on this card for each die.

success.description: A second opponent in the engagement suffers 1 wound.
{De} {Dc} - If both have been invested in this Enhance, you strike a second eligible target.

reckless.requirements: Two melee weapons equipped, Weapon Skill & Intimidation trained. Enhances a Melee Attack: Play this card when you make a Melee Attack. You may remove dice from your dice pool. If you do, you gain the bonuses listed on this card for each die. The attack gains +1 damage.
